chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) inherited the knowledge of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and Fatima (peace be upon her) inherited his wealth.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What did Fatima inherit from the Prophet Muhammad according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* articulates the Shia doctrine of dual inheritance, distinguishing between the esoteric knowledge (*'Ilm*) transmitted to Imam Ali (AS) and the material wealth (*Mal*) inherited by Fatima al-Zahra (AS). This distinction underscores the unique spiritual authority of the Imams as successors to the Prophet's inner teachings, while affirming the practical legal inheritance rights of the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the complementary roles of Ali and Fatima in preserving the complete legacy of prophethood.
